decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly combo off by using cards like Hermit Druid and Phyrexian Dreadnought to fill up the graveyard, and then bringing back powerful creatures like Sutured Ghoul with spells like Reanimate and Shallow Grave. The deck includes disruptive elements like Stifle and Duress to control the game and protect the combo. The use of cards like Lotus Petal and Elvish Spirit Guide allows for explosive plays, while cards like Worldly Tutor and Cabal Therapy provide consistency and disruption. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through a powerful graveyard-based combo strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, disrupting the opponent with discard spells, and removal to control the board. The combination of powerful creatures like Exalted Angel and Hypnotic Specter, along with disruption from Duress and Gerrard's Verdict, allows for early pressure and hand disruption. The removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate help to keep the opponent's threats in check. The deck also utilizes land disruption with Wasteland to slow down the opponent's mana development. The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruption spells.

The main concept of this Deadguy Ale deck is to apply aggressive pressure on the opponent using efficient creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Nantuko Shade, backed up by disruption spells like Duress and Gerrard's Verdict. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate to deal with threats, while cards like Phyrexian Arena provide card advantage. The deck aims to control the game early on, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and eventually close out the game with efficient creatures and removal spells.

The deck focuses on using aggressive Elves to generate mana quickly and overwhelm the opponent with numerous creatures. It includes cards that allow for flexibility and card advantage, as well as a few powerful creatures like Masticore and Kamahl, Fist of Krosa. The deck aims to ramp up mana production early on, and maintain board presence through efficient creature management with cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger. Overall, the strategy is to quickly build a strong board state and push for a win before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures with the ability to be flexible in order to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It also includes burn spells and removal to maintain board control and finish off the opponent. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and proactive, aiming to put pressure on the opponent from the start and maintain that pressure throughout the game. The key concept is to be efficient and relentless in attacking the opponent while also being able to deal with any threats the opponent may present.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of powerful creatures and spells. The deck includes a mix of angels, mages, and runes to protect the player and disrupt their opponent's strategy. It also includes various instant spells like Lightning Bolt and Swords to Plowshares for removal, along with card draw spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Fact or Fiction to maintain card advantage. The deck's mana base is designed to provide a variety of colors to support the different spells and creatures included in the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain control over the game by constantly removing and disrupting the opponent's resources and game plan. It focuses on utilizing Mono Black Control cards and strategies to gain advantage. The deck includes various removal spells like Diabolic Edict, Smother, and Innocent Blood, as well as hand disruption with Duress. It also includes powerful finishers like Corrupt and Avatar of Woe. The deck aims to generate card advantage with Phyrexian Arena and achieve mana advantage through Cabal Coffers. Overall, the core idea is to establish and maintain control through resource manipulation and card advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using Oath of Druids and various enchantments like Parallax Tide and Parallax Wave to manipulate the board. The deck leverages cards like Frantic Search, Attunement, and Replenish to draw cards and set up powerful combos. Additionally, cards like Saproling Burst and Pandemonium can be used to create a win condition once the deck has established control. The deck also includes mana acceleration with cards like Mox Diamond and Ancient Tomb to help ramp up and cast its high-cost spells.

The deck focuses on playing small, aggressive creatures and direct damage spells to put pressure on the opponent quickly. The key strategy is to maintain a fast and relentless pace, utilizing cards like Ball Lightning, Grim Lavamancer, and Lightning Bolt to deal damage efficiently. By combining creature attacks with burn spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish a strong defense. Sulfuric Vortex and Cursed Scroll provide additional sources of damage over time, while Fireblast offers a powerful finisher to end the game decisively.

The main focus of this deck is to establish a lock on the opponent using Stasis and Forsaken City, preventing them from untapping their lands and effectively shutting down their ability to play spells. Through card draw and counter spells such as Gush, Impulse, and Arcane Denial, the deck aims to maintain control while slowly chipping away at the opponent's life total with Black Vise. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Root Maze and Chain of Vapor further adds to the deck's strategy of stalling and locking down the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggression and land destruction, utilizing cards like Armageddon and Terravore to disrupt opponents and gain board control. With the ability to ramp up land drops using Mox Diamond and Land Tax, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures like Werebear. Additionally, cards like Meddling Mage and Scroll Rack provide disruption and card advantage, while cards like Swords to Plowshares and Pyroclasm offer removal options. Overall, this deck aims to control the battlefield and apply pressure to opponents early on to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards with abilities that allow for discarding and utilizing cards in the graveyard, such as Madness and Threshold mechanics. By quickly filling up the graveyard and taking advantage of cards like Wild Mongrel and Circular Logic, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive early plays. The key strategy is to efficiently use resources in the graveyard to maintain pressure and control, ultimately leading to a swift victory through proactive plays and strong synergy between cards.

The primary focus of the deck is to control the game by efficiently countering spells and removing threats with cards like Counterspell, Mana Leak, and Swords to Plowshares. It also emphasizes card advantage through Impulse, Accumulated Knowledge, and Fact or Fiction. The inclusion of land destruction with Dust Bowl helps to maintain control over the board, while win conditions like Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave provide a way to close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The core idea of this Aggro - White Weenie deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient creatures while disrupting their game plan with removal spells and land destruction. By utilizing cards like Swords to Plowshares and Master Apothecary to protect our creatures, combined with Armageddon to gain a tempo advantage, we aim to quickly establish board control and press the advantage to victory. The inclusion of cards like Shared Triumph and Weathered Wayfarer further enhance our creature strategy, providing additional support and flexibility in our game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing Zombie Infestation to create a swarm of tokens, while also having creatures that can be discarded for value. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggro creatures like Wild Mongrel and Arrogant Wurm, while also disrupting their gameplan with cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress. The inclusion of Survival of the Fittest allows for tutoring for key creatures, and Exhume can bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard. The deck has a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to put pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly.
